prompt: Single continuous shot. Three ingredients in hard spotlight: one egg, one very ripe spotted banana, a jar of oats — one second still. Then motion: the banana mashed under a fork in macro, egg cracked over it, oats raining in, whisked thick. Money shot: small pancakes bubbling in butter, one flipped high in slow motion landing golden; butter foaming golden around the edges as the stack builds, banana coins laid over the top, backlit. Final beat: a fork pressing through the soft stack, steam rising. Warm morning light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the fork mash, then the butter sizzle. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption: Como prometido: o trio esquecido da fruteira. Panqueca de verdade sem farinha e sem açúcar — a banana madura É o doce. **Sábado que vem: [A] salsicha, batata e requeijão ou [B] sardinha em lata, macarrão e limão? Comenta A ou B 👇**
